description.value: Indian Essence Bistro is an authentic Indian restaurant in Fort St. John, BC, where a chef with experience in India's 5-star hotels serves an extensive menu of meat and vegetarian dishes in an elegant dining room suited to intimate dinners or group events. The menu spans tandoori grills, biryanis, curries, and a full vegetarian selection. Online ordering and local food delivery are also available.

address.value: 10123 100 Street, Fort St. John, BC V1J 3Y6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at indianessencebistro.ca is active and confirms the business name, address (10123, 100 Street Fort St. John BC V1J 3Y6), and phone (250-785-6636), all matching OSM tags. The site features an 'Order Now' button and a $5 local food delivery service confirming takeout capability, and lists a dedicated Vegetarian Menu section with many dishes. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, device charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
